sentences.text:
Helal Hussen vs The State Of Tripura on 8 August, 2025
2
 High Court Of Tripura
I.A. No.1 of 2025 in Crl. A. No.31 of 2025

Helal Hussen
 ---- Applicant(s)
 Versus
The State of Tripura
 ----Respondent(s)
For Applicant(s) : Mr. Manojit Saha, Adv.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Raju Datta, P.P. Hon'Ble Mr.
Justice Biswajit Palit Order 08/08/2025 Heard Learned Counsel, Mr. Manojit Saha
appearing on behalf of the appellant-applicant and also heard Learned P.P., Mr. Raju Datta
appearing on behalf of the respondent-State.

The appellant-applicant has preferred an appeal under Section 374(2) of Cr.P.C. challenging the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 20.06.2025 delivered by Learned Sessions Judge, North Tripura, Dharmanagar in connection with case No.S.T.(Type-2)/32/2021.

entities.text: Learned Sessions Judge, North Tripura, Dharmanagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By the said judgment and order of conviction and sentence, Learned Sessions Judge has found the appellant-applicant to be guilty under Section 498A of IPC and sentenced him to suffer RI for two years and also to pay a fine of Rs.5,000/- i.d. to suffer imprisonment for further three months.

Along with the memo of appeal, another application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C read with Section 374(2) of Cr.P.C. is filed by the appellant-applicant for suspending the judgment and order of conviction & sentence.
This Court has already admitted the appeal.

So, the sentence imposed by Learned Sessions Judge be suspended till disposal of this appeal subject to execution of bond of Rs. 30,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of Learned Trial Court.
With this observation, the present Interlocutory application stands disposed of.
A copy of this order be supplied to Learned Counsel for the appellant-applicant.
Also, a copy of this order be communicated to Learned Sessions Judge, North Tripura, Dharmanagar.
